name: Size / Dual Littlestone Dimension
details: Every finite binary class satisfies $|\mathcal H|\ge\mathrm L^*(\mathcal H)$.
proof: A depth-d shattered tree in $\mathcal H^*$ has $2^d$ leaves realized by distinct coordinate functions. There are at most $2^{|\mathcal H|}$ distinct binary functions on the domain $\mathcal H$, so $2^d\le2^{|\mathcal H|}$ and $d\le|\mathcal H|$.
witness_verification: For the full n-cube, size is $2^n$ while $\mathrm L^*=\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor$.
